# Source content digest cases

`cases.json` is a byte-for-byte copy of `testdata/sourcecontent/cases.json`
from stokaro/ptah-operator at commit
`e9543f6db1c2924f1020e3910a73b998338b1d9b`, where the content digest is
defined. Ptah's Git pull computes the same digest, and its tests hold it to
every case here. Replace the file with the operator's when that one changes;
never edit it here.
